method: Native MediaRecorder VP8/Opus. Canvas frames captured immediately after actual WebGL render; original realtime post-limiter game sound, no gain change or normalization. Ordinary automatic OSM walk at 800×600 balanced, 32 seconds wall time, no simulation speed-up. The separate river clip uses an explicit diagnostic station switch, not a continuous walking route. Its weather/moment changes use the ordinary UI. Frames retain their actual timestamps; SwiftShader, not physical GPU performance.

contact.basis: explicit OSM hard surface; generic hard-contact recording
